title: ENS Foundation Tier C (v1)
summary: High-value, contested, or committee-heavy rounds with stronger preservation, protected bundles, and Phase II when AI is material.

phase2Policy.notes: Phase II when automated evaluators materially inform recommendation. Production C2 requires an accepted external trust policy; fixture profiles never establish production C2.

policySourceCapture.notes: Strong source preservation and pinning required for governing-policy artifacts.

operatorConfirmations.description: Confirm which artifact governs each of the five decision surfaces.
Confirm whether each gate is eligibility versus merit evaluation.
Confirm evaluator participation versus roster membership.
Confirm committee/human authority, quorum, and decision rule.
Confirm conflict status, recusal, and substitution.
Confirm whether a finding is supported fact, judgment, uncertainty, or unverified claim.
Confirm unavailable versus protected fields and redaction basis.
Confirm whether automated evaluation was materially influential.
Confirm whether a production C2/C3 claim is intended and which trust policy applies.

nonGoals: No merit scoring or approve/reject recommendation engine.
No inference of eligibility without operator confirmation.
No automated conflict resolution or invented quorum.
No assignment of institutional authority by the adapter or Phase II objects.
No ENS endorsement claim from profile use alone.

burdenBudget.intent: Higher reconstruction strength for contested or high-value rounds.
burdenBudget.notes: Expect protected bundle, projection worksheet, and Phase II when AI is material.
